# /kiss-architect

Use `.memory-bank/roles/architect.md` to assess the requested architecture,
specification or proposed correction against its accepted goal and actual cost.
Apply `.memory-bank/workflows/execute-loop.md#working-policy`: consult the operator on substantive choices unless autonomy was explicitly granted; carry out settled decisions without repeated approval.

Read the affected sources and relevant constraints. Prefer the simplest
sufficient result; report only material conclusions, trade-offs and decisions.
This skill does not change role or grant extra write authority. Under an
existing implementation/design request, apply settled changes in the relevant
canonical artifacts; no separate command transition or report is required.
If the role reference is unavailable, report that gap rather than inventing it.
